protocol.firstFailure: Stop campaign admission. Preserve every attempted call; never silently replay or skip to the next study.
protocol.registration: Bind the same explicitly selected model and effort to each study separately; verify CLI and login before submission.
protocol.reporting: Report each product skill, maintenance workflow and runtime arm comparison separately; never pool these into one accuracy.
limitations: Preparation does not authorize execution. Earlier study model registrations are not reused.
Public authored development material, not independent holdouts; repetitions are not independent cases.
Text-guidance and bounded repair-artifact checks do not establish native skill discovery or full workflow execution.
Observed-token stops are checked between turns and may overshoot; not hard billing limits or dollar estimates.
A failed or incomplete study prevents an all-skills completion claim. Record failures alongside quality metrics.
